scope: Bundled OpenCode Anthropic model metadata and official provider lifecycle/pricing; no agent task or provider inference executed.

method.home_config_data_cache: empty temporary directories under /tmp; no host auth or configuration mounted
method.provider_initialization: A synthetic nonsecret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY token activated bundled provider enumeration. Its value is not retained. No real credential was read or passed.
method.initial_no_credential_result: Provider not found: anthropic; this reflects provider initialization, not absence of the model from the bundled catalog.

provider_documentation.snapshot_semantics: Anthropic states that dateless model IDs from the 4.6 generation are pinned model snapshots, not floating aliases.
provider_documentation.long_context: Standard pricing applies across the full 1M context for Claude Sonnet 4.6.

sources.supports: Exact API ID, pricing, active legacy status and retirement commitment.
Pinned semantics of dateless 4.6 and later model IDs.
Global standard pricing, cache categories and full-context pricing.
Lifecycle of selected and excluded earlier candidates.

limitations: Installed catalog presence and metadata do not establish account entitlement or server acceptance of a real request.
Catalog output limits and reasoning variants describe this harness; they do not establish matched effective inference settings across harnesses.
Claude Code and Pi compatibility checks are recorded by the parent model-selection work; this file directly records only OpenCode enumeration.
Provider pricing and lifecycle are a documentation snapshot, not measured task cost or a guarantee that a specific account has access.
